facts.text: I have been contributing to my 401(k) for a few years.
I only have about 2 months' worth of expenses saved up in my emergency fund.
I want to build my emergency fund up to 3-6 months' worth of expenses.
I plan to review my budget to cut back on discretionary spending.
I plan to reallocate funds from my entertainment budget to my emergency fund.
I plan to cancel subscription services that I don't use as much anymore.
I plan to increase my income by taking on freelance work on the side.
I plan to track my progress by regularly reviewing my budget and checking my emergency fund balance.
I plan to set reminders for myself to review my budget and emergency fund every few months.
I want to remind myself that building an emergency fund is for peace of mind and financial security.
I plan to celebrate small wins when I reach milestones in my emergency fund savings.
I plan to make saving for my emergency fund a habit by automating my savings.
I plan to make saving for my emergency fund a regular part of my financial routine.

events.text: Review budget and reallocate money to build emergency fund
Set reminders to review budget and emergency fund every few months
Reach emergency fund savings milestones and celebrate small wins
